만세력 annual anchor 1984=甲子; 1992 = 壬申 (60-cycle (1992+56)%60=32)

notes: Reference date = Harish's W1-certified birth date. The sewoon hit for 1992 must equal the certified year pillar 壬申; the 월운 hit for 199206 must equal the certified month pillar 乙巳 (五虎遁 from 壬). Annual idx check: 1984=甲子(0) → 1992=idx 8=壬申. NON-CIRCULAR: expectations come from the W1-certified pillar layer — the expected annual pillar equals the reference chart's W1-certified year pillar and the expected monthly pillar equals its W1-certified month pillar, so sewoon's independent 1984=甲子 annual anchor and 五虎遁 monthly anchor are cross-validated against the certified pillar layer, not against sewoon itself. Longitude corrected 2026-09-14 from 76.33 to 79.42: 76.33 is the known-wrong output of the `--city Pallipat` geocoder (see src/saju_engine/pillars.py:218 and docs/audits/2026-07-05-engine-audit.md C4) and was never Harish's birthplace longitude — the candidate record gives Pallipattu (Tiruvallur) at 79.45°E and the published report corrects -12.2 min to 02:57 solar. The change is pillar-neutral: both 76.33 (-24.7 min, 02:45) and 79.42 (-12.3 min, 02:57) land inside the 丑 hour window, so every expectation in this entry is unchanged.
